perplexity.description:
Angels & Queens is the debut studio album by Compton soul trio Gabriels, released in two parts by Parlophone and Atlas Artists. Part I arrived on September 30, 2022, followed by Part II on July 7, 2023, with the complete album running approximately 49 minutes. The project was produced by the trio—vocalist Jacob Lusk alongside producers Ari Balouzian and Ryan Hope—in collaboration with hip-hop producer Sounwave, establishing a sophisticated sonic foundation that blends contemporary soul with vintage influences.

The album showcases Gabriels' command of soulful, emotionally resonant arrangements, drawing from both classic soul traditions and modern R&B sensibilities. Standout tracks like the title song "Angels & Queens," "Taboo," and "To The Moon And Back" demonstrate the band's ability to craft dramatically paced compositions with meticulous attention to instrumentation and vocal delivery. The inclusion of their signature track "Love & Hate In A Different Time"—reimagined for this project—underscores the album's thematic depth and the group's evolution as songwriters.

Part I received widespread critical acclaim upon its September 2022 release, with some critics considering it among the year's best albums. The addition of Part II's six new tracks elevated the complete work to what reviewers described as "a whole different level," cementing Angels & Queens as a significant statement from an emerging force in contemporary soul music.
